allot.subject: Disclosure of material issue
allot.text: This is to intimate you that, based on the recommendation of the Nomination, Remuneration and Compensation Committee, the Board of Directors of the Company accorded their approval on December 31, 2025 for the allotment of 6,00,289 (Six Lakh Two Hundred Eighty Nine only) equity shares at a face value of Rs. 10/- each to the eligible employees of the Company in accordance with the terms of  Transwarranty Employee Stock Option Plan- 2019 .

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Transwarranty Finance Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025 and Approved issuance of unlisted Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) on Private Placement basis
